messages:
Alex Kim: Draft PRD for Dedicated autoscale + SLA targets. Posting rough scope — need PM + infra + SRE input by EOD Thursday. Link: https://redwood.docs/drive/prd/autoscale-dedicated (draft)

Mira Chen: @Alex Kim added a few questions in the doc about cold-starts and scale-up granularity. Do we have data on current pod spin-up times?

Sam Ortiz: We measured GPU node attach + model load ~ 8-12s for p4.xlarge; warm pool can drop that to <200ms. Numbers in infra board.

Jon Patel: For launch criteria, we should require: 1) end-to-end test passing (latency & throughput); 2) rollback policy; 3) runbook + SLOs. +1 on requiring warm pool config.

Alex Kim: Agreed. Draft acceptance criteria added to doc. TL;DR:
```
- P99 latency <= 150ms for <=512 tokens on small models
- Throughput bench: sustained 600 req/s per 8-GPU pool for model X
- Autoscale scale-up <= 5s (if warm pool) / <= 30s cold
- Canary rollout + automatic fallback to hosted variant
```

Mira Chen: Edge case: burst of many small requests from a single customer. How do we avoid noisy-neighboring causing eviction? Suggest per-customer min pool reservations or token-based rate limiting.

Sam Ortiz: We'll add a per-tenant reservation flag in Dedicated config. Implementation note: min_reserved_gpus: int, reservation_ttl.

Laura Gomez: Can we quantify cost delta for reserving 1 GPU per tenant? Need in PRD for customer tradeoffs section.

Alex Kim: Good call — @finance please ping for a delta calc. I put placeholder numbers.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for autoscale-pr-1748 on infra-stage at 2026-03-18T14:08Z :rocket:

Jon Patel: Running load test now against canary, starting with 10k RPS spike pattern. Will post results.

Jon Patel: Load test quick summary: 10k RPS spike -> warm pool served 95% under 150ms p99, cold nodes caused 5% 500-800ms. Individual trace: `model.load` dominated.

Mira Chen: Acceptance criteria suggestion: require <1% calls >300ms during 10k RPS spike for warm-pool enabled runs.

Alex Kim: Updated doc with Mira's metric. Next steps: PM sign-off, finance estimate, infra implementation ETA. Anyone blocking?

Sam Ortiz: Blocker: need final kernel + quantization matrix for model X before we can guarantee throughput numbers.

Laura Gomez: I'm okay to sign off on scope if finance provides cost delta and eng confirms kernel plan.

Alex Kim: Great. I'll schedule a 30m sync Fri 10am to lock scope and assign owners. Agenda posted in doc.

Mira Chen: :thumbsup:
